papers.title: Submucosal Lidocaine Injection in Colonic Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Single-Center, Double-Blind, Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.journal_full: Digestive endoscopy : official journal of the Japan Gastroenterological Endoscopy Society
papers.authors: Ueda T, Kanesaka T, Ando Y, Tani Y, Tanabe G, Fujimoto Y
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Colonic spasm is one of the major technical challenges encountered during colonic endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), impairing visualization of the dissection plane and scope maneuverability. Submucosal lidocaine injection may help to overcome this challenge. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of submucosal lidocaine injection during colonic ESD.
METHODS: In this single-center, double-blind, randomized controlled trial, 110 patients scheduled for colonic ESD were randomly assigned to the lidocaine or control group. In the lidocaine group, 1% lidocaine with 0.6% sodium alginate was used for submucosal injection; in the control group, saline with 0.6% sodium alginate was used. The primary outcome was procedure time. Secondary outcomes included en bloc and R0 resection rates, incidence of severe spasms, number of antispasmodic administrations, operator satisfaction, and adverse events.
RESULTS: The median procedure time was numerically shorter in the lidocaine group but did not reach statistical significance (67.5 vs. 78.0 min, p = 0.114). The en bloc and R0 resection rates were 100% and 84.6% in the lidocaine group, and 96.3% and 81.5% in the control group, respectively. Severe spasms occurred less frequently in the lidocaine group (34.6% vs. 74.1%), with fewer antispasmodic administrations (median, 1 vs. 2) and higher operator satisfaction scores (median, 4.0 vs. 2.5). No increase in adverse events was observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Submucosal lidocaine injection did not significantly shorten procedure time, although it may serve as a useful adjunct for preventing colonic spasms during ESD.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: The study was registered in the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials (jRCT1051230189).

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：大腸痙攣是大腸ESD過程中主要的技術挑戰之一，會影響剝離平面的視野與內視鏡操控性。黏膜下注射利多卡因可能有助於克服此困難。本研究旨在評估大腸ESD中黏膜下注射利多卡因的療效與安全性。方法：此為單中心、雙盲、隨機對照試驗，110名預計接受大腸ESD的患者隨機分配至利多卡因組或對照組。利多卡因組使用1%利多卡因加0.6%海藻酸鈉進行黏膜下注射；對照組使用生理食鹽水加0.6%海藻酸鈉。主要終點為手術時間。次要終點包括整塊切除率（en bloc）與R0切除率、嚴重痙攣發生率、止痙藥使用次數、操作者滿意度及不良事件。結果：利多卡因組手術時間中位數在數值上較短，但未達統計顯著（67.5分 vs 78.0分，p=0.114）。利多卡因組與對照組的整塊切除率分別為100%與96.3%，R0切除率分別為84.6%與81.5%。利多卡因組嚴重痙攣發生率較低（34.6% vs 74.1%），止痙藥使用次數較少（中位數1次 vs 2次），操作者滿意度分數較高（中位數4.0 vs 2.5）。未觀察到不良事件增加。結論：黏膜下注射利多卡因未能顯著縮短手術時間，但可能作為預防大腸ESD過程中痙攣的有用輔助手段。試驗註冊：本研究已於日本臨床試驗註冊中心登記（jRCT1051230189）。
papers.score_reason: 雙盲隨機對照設計嚴謹且有試驗註冊，但主要終點（手術時間）未達顯著差異，單中心、樣本量中等（n=110），對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床決策的直接影響有限。

papers.title: Sexual dysfunction outcomes and reporting disparities after multimodal treatment for rectal cancer: A systematic review and narrative synthesis
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Lakshmanan V, Waterman J, Meggy A, Torkington J, Cornish J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Sexual dysfunction is a recognised adverse outcome after rectal cancer treatments, yet reporting is predominantly male-focused, with female sexual dysfunction less consistently assessed or reported. This systematic review aimed to assess sexual health domains studied, examine sex-based reporting disparities, and identify limitations in the current evidence.
METHODS: A systematic review and narrative synthesis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA and registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251178502). PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, Scopus, CINAHL Plus, PsycINFO, and Cochrane Library were searched from March 1995 to March 2025, with an updated search to March 2026. Eligible studies included adults treated for rectal cancer in whom sexual function outcomes were assessed using International Index of Erectile Function (IIEF) and/or Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI), with additional related patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) accepted where relevant. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and MINORS.
RESULTS: Twenty-five studies involving 4,071 patients were included. Participants were predominantly male (65.8%), while women comprised 34.2%. PROM reporting was inconsistent; only eight studies reported both total and domain-level results. Sexual outcomes were most consistently reported for men, particularly erectile and ejaculatory function, whereas female outcomes were often reduced to overall scores. Five studies restricted sexual outcome assessment and analysis to men. Only six reported response rates, and missing PROM data handling was not described. Key contextual variables, including sexual activity, sexual orientation, sexual practices, and menopausal status, were rarely captured.
CONCLUSIONS: Sexual function outcomes after rectal cancer treatment are inconsistently reported, with low certainty. Female sexual dysfunction remains under-represented. Standardised, inclusive sex-specific reporting and development of a core outcome set are needed.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌多模式治療後性功能障礙結果與報告落差：系統性回顧與敘事整合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：性功能障礙是直腸癌治療後公認的不良結果，然而相關報告以男性為主，女性性功能障礙較少被一致地評估或報告。本系統性回顧旨在評估已研究的性健康領域、檢視性別報告落差，並找出現有證據的限制。

方法：依據PRISMA進行系統性回顧與敘事整合分析，並於PROSPERO註冊（CRD420251178502）。檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE、Scopus、CINAHL Plus、PsycINFO及Cochrane Library，時間範圍自1995年3月至2025年3月，並於2026年3月進行更新檢索。納入條件為：接受直腸癌治療的成人，使用國際勃起功能指標（IIEF）及/或女性性功能指標（FSFI）評估性功能結果，並可納入其他相關的病人報告結果測量（PROMs）。偏誤風險使用RoB 2與MINORS評估。

結果：共納入25篇研究，涵蓋4,071名病人。參與者以男性為主（65.8%），女性佔34.2%。PROM報告方式不一致；僅8篇研究同時報告總分與領域層級結果。性功能結果對男性的報告最為一致，特別是勃起與射精功能，而女性結果常被簡化為總分。5篇研究將性功能評估與分析僅限於男性。僅6篇報告回覆率，且未描述遺漏PROM資料的處理方式。重要的情境變項，包括性活動狀況、性傾向、性行為模式及更年期狀態，甚少被記錄。

結論：直腸癌治療後的性功能結果報告不一致，證據確定性偏低。女性性功能障礙仍嚴重被低估報告。需要建立標準化、涵蓋兩性的報告方式，並發展核心結果集。
papers.score_reason: 方法嚴謹（PRISMA、PROSPERO註冊、RoB評估），揭露真實存在的證據缺口，但結論屬於「呼籲改善報告品質」，非直接可用於臨床決策的療效數據。

papers.title: Selective Packaging of miR-22 and miR-29 Orthologues into Extracellular Vesicles of the Porcine Whipworm Trichuris Suis
papers.authors: Whitehead B, Mardahl M, Hansen E, Fromm B, Borup A, Boysen A
papers.abstract: Helminths modulate host immunity, and in this respect, the porcine whipworm Trichuris suis has been explored clinically as an immunotherapy for inflammatory diseases. T. suis secretes a complex mixture of excretory/secretory products (ESP), including extracellular vesicles (EVs), nanosized membranous particles with bioactive cargoes of lipids, proteins and nucleic acids that are implicated in intercellular communication within organisms. Here, we characterise the EV protein and miRNA cargo of T. suis to identify potential roles in host-parasite communication. In contrast to EVs from clade III/V helminth species characterised to date, we show that T. suis EVs did not suppress LPS-induced TNF production by human macrophages under the conditions tested, in contrast to non-vesicular ESP fractions which did. By generating the first extracellular miRNA complement for T. suis and quantifying EV-associated versus free miRNAs across larval and adult stages, we identify selective enrichment of two miRNAs in adult EVs with homology to human miR-22-3p and miR-29-3p, canonical anti-fibrotic and tumour-suppressor miRNAs. Functional assays in human colon cancer epithelial cells reveal that these helminth-derived orthologues downregulate conserved oncogenic targets, indicating evolutionary conservation of their regulatory capacity. Our findings uncover a previously unrecognised axis of whipworm biology in which selective EV-mediated export of anti-fibrotic miRNAs has the potential to modulate host tissue remodeling independently of classical immunomodulation, with implications for understanding helminth-driven epithelial homeostasis and cancer risk.

papers.title_zh: 豬鞭蟲（Trichuris suis）胞外囊泡中miR-22與miR-29同源物之選擇性包裝
papers.abstract_zh: 蠕蟲可調節宿主免疫功能，就此而言，豬鞭蟲已在臨床上被探索作為發炎性疾病的免疫療法。豬鞭蟲分泌複雜的排泄/分泌產物（ESP）混合物，其中包括胞外囊泡（EVs）——一種含有脂質、蛋白質及核酸等生物活性貨物的奈米級膜狀顆粒，被認為參與生物體內細胞間通訊。本研究對豬鞭蟲EV的蛋白質與miRNA貨物進行特徵分析，以確認其在宿主-寄生蟲通訊中的潛在角色。與目前已知的Clade III/V蠕蟲物種EV不同，我們發現在測試條件下，豬鞭蟲EV並未抑制人類巨噬細胞中LPS誘導的TNF產生，而非囊泡型ESP組分則具有此抑制作用。透過建立豬鞭蟲首個胞外miRNA全譜，並量化幼蟲與成蟲階段中EV相關與游離miRNA的差異，我們發現兩個在成蟲EV中選擇性富集的miRNA，分別與人類miR-22-3p及miR-29-3p同源，此二者為經典的抗纖維化與腫瘤抑制型miRNA。在人類大腸癌上皮細胞中進行的功能性試驗顯示，這些蠕蟲來源的同源miRNA可下調保守的致癌基因靶點，顯示其調節能力具有演化保守性。本研究發現一條先前未被認識的鞭蟲生物學軸線，其中EV媒介的選擇性抗纖維化miRNA輸出，可能獨立於典型免疫調節機制之外調節宿主組織重塑，對於理解蠕蟲驅動之上皮同質性與癌症風險具有意義。

papers.title: Agathobacter rectalis suppresses colorectal tumorigenesis via an epigallocatechin-SREBF2 axis controlling cholesterol metabolism
papers.authors: Lu J, Sun Y, Zeng Y, Lau E, Lan Z, Ye S
papers.abstract: Beneficial effects of the gut commensal Agathobacter rectalis (Ar) are reported in diseases, yet its role in colorectal cancer (CRC) remains unclear. Here, metagenomic analysis revealed consistent fecal Ar depletion across CRC cohorts. In Apc min/+ mice, Ar inhibited colon tumorigenesis, reducing tumor number and volume versus E. coli and PBS controls. LC-MS/MS metabolomics showed decreased fecal cholesterol and altered lipid/cholesterol pathways after Ar treatment. In vitro, Ar-conditioned medium suppressed CRC cell growth, clonogenicity, migration, and cell cycle progression. LC-MS/MS identified (-)-epigallocatechin (EGC) as an Ar-derived metabolite absent in control bacteria. EGC recapitulated Ar-mediated anti-CRC effects in vitro and in vivo, with metabolic changes linked to lipid/cholesterol pathways. Transcriptomics showed that EGC suppressed SREBP signaling, cholesterol metabolism, and MAPK pathways. Mechanistically, EGC reduced nuclear SREBF2 and its transcriptional activity, downregulated cholesterol synthesis/metabolism genes, including FDPS and PCSK9, and suppressed MAPK signaling. Molecular docking suggested that EGC may bind pSREBF2 or SCAP. Cellular thermal shift assay revealed that EGC interacts with and stabilizes pSREBF2, but not SCAP. Co-immunoprecipitation demonstrated that EGC reduces pSREBF2-SCAP interaction, thereby inhibiting SCAP-mediated SREBF2 cleavage activation. Together, these findings define an Ar-EGC microbe-metabolite axis and support Ar/EGC-based interventions targeting cholesterol metabolism in CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 腸道共生菌Agathobacter rectalis (Ar)在多種疾病中已被報導具有有益作用，但其在大腸直腸癌(CRC)中的角色仍不清楚。本研究中，總體基因體分析顯示在多個CRC世代中糞便Ar持續減少。在Apc min/+小鼠中，相較於大腸桿菌(E. coli)與PBS對照組，Ar可抑制大腸腫瘤發生，減少腫瘤數量與體積。LC-MS/MS代謝體學顯示Ar處理後糞便膽固醇降低，脂質/膽固醇路徑改變。在體外實驗中，Ar條件培養液可抑制CRC細胞生長、群落形成能力、遷移能力及細胞週期進展。LC-MS/MS鑑定出(-)-epigallocatechin (EGC)為Ar衍生代謝物，此代謝物在對照菌中未檢出。EGC在體外與體內均重現了Ar介導的抗CRC效果，其代謝變化與脂質/膽固醇路徑相關。轉錄體學顯示EGC抑制SREBP訊息傳遞、膽固醇代謝及MAPK路徑。機轉上，EGC降低細胞核SREBF2及其轉錄活性，下調膽固醇合成/代謝基因（包括FDPS與PCSK9），並抑制MAPK訊息傳遞。分子對接顯示EGC可能與pSREBF2或SCAP結合。細胞熱位移分析顯示EGC與pSREBF2交互作用並使其穩定，但不影響SCAP。免疫共沉澱顯示EGC降低pSREBF2-SCAP交互作用，從而抑制SCAP介導的SREBF2剪切活化。總體而言，這些發現定義了一條Ar-EGC微生物-代謝物軸，支持以Ar/EGC為基礎、針對CRC膽固醇代謝的介入策略。

papers.title: Clinicopathologic Characteristics, Treatments, and Survival Outcomes of Early-onset Compared to Later-onset Colorectal Mucinous Adenocarcinomas: A Population-based SEER Analysis
papers.authors: Emile S, Barnes S, Garoufalia Z, Wexner S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma (CMA) is a unique subtype of adenocarcinoma. This study aimed to compare characteristics, treatments, and survival outcomes of early-onset and later-onset CMA.
METHODS: This investigation was a retrospective cohort study from the National Cancer Institute's SEER Research Data database from 2000 to 2022 on patients with CMA. Patients aged < 50 years (early-onset) and patients aged ≥ 50 years (later-onset) were compared regarding disease characteristics, treatments, and survival. The main outcome measures were 5-year overall survival (OS) and cancer-specific survival (CSS).
RESULTS: The study included 55,853 patients; 10.4% of them presented with early-onset disease. Early-onset CMA more often affected males, Blacks, and Hispanics, and was more advanced and more often associated with liver metastases. Early-onset CMA was associated with higher 5-year OS (57.7% vs. 47.5%, p < 0.001) and CSS (58.4% vs. 45.4%, p < 0.001). In multivariable Cox proportional hazard analysis excluding postdiagnosis treatment variables, later-onset CMA was associated with higher all-cause mortality (HR: 1.69, 95% CI 1.53-1.87, p < 0.001) and cancer-specific mortality (HR: 1.45, 95% CI 1.30-1.61, p < 0.001) compared to early-onset disease. In a sensitivity analysis adjusting for treatment variables, these associations persisted, although they were attenuated for both OS (HR: 1.56, 95% CI 1.41-1.72, p < 0.001) and CSS (HR: 1.34, 95% CI 1.20-1.49, p < 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: Early-onset CMA presented with different demographic and disease characteristics and treatment patterns than later-onset disease. Survival of early-onset CMA was higher than later-onset CMA.
papers.title_zh: 早發型與晚發型大腸直腸黏液性腺癌之臨床病理特徵、治療與存活結果比較：以SEER資料庫為基礎之分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：大腸直腸黏液性腺癌（CMA）是腺癌中獨特的亞型。本研究旨在比較早發型與晚發型CMA之特徵、治療與存活結果。方法：本研究為回溯性世代研究，資料來自美國國家癌症研究所SEER Research Data資料庫，涵蓋2000至2022年之CMA患者。比較年齡<50歲（早發型）與≥50歲（晚發型）患者之疾病特徵、治療與存活。主要結果指標為五年整體存活率（OS）與癌症特異存活率（CSS）。結果：本研究共納入55,853名患者；其中10.4%為早發型疾病。早發型CMA較常見於男性、黑人與西班牙裔，且分期較晚、較常合併肝轉移。早發型CMA具有較高之五年OS（57.7% vs. 47.5%，p<0.001）與CSS（58.4% vs. 45.4%，p<0.001）。在排除診斷後治療變項之多變量Cox比例風險分析中，晚發型CMA相較於早發型疾病之全因死亡率較高（HR: 1.69，95% CI 1.53-1.87，p<0.001），癌症特異死亡率亦較高（HR: 1.45，95% CI 1.30-1.61，p<0.001）。在校正治療變項之敏感性分析中，此關聯仍持續存在，惟OS（HR: 1.56，95% CI 1.41-1.72，p<0.001）與CSS（HR: 1.34，95% CI 1.20-1.49，p<0.001）之效應皆有所減弱。結論：早發型CMA呈現與晚發型疾病不同之人口學特徵、疾病特徵與治療模式。早發型CMA之存活優於晚發型CMA。

papers.title: Impact of robotic platform transition on short term outcomes in colorectal cancer surgeries
papers.authors: Nahime R, Stevanato Filho P, Bezerra T, Marques T, Takahashi R, Kupper B
papers.abstract: Robotic colorectal surgery is increasingly complex, expanding from pelvic to multiquadrant procedures. Reports on the impact of institutional robotic platform transition remain limited. This study evaluated the challenges and effects of transitioning from the da Vinci Si (dV Si) to the da Vinci X/Xi (dV X/Xi) platform. A prospective observational cohort with historical comparison describing an institutional experience that included consecutive elective robotic colorectal cancer resections performed in 2023 (dV Si) and 2024 (dV X/Xi). The primary endpoint was the learning curve for console time. Secondary outcomes included total operative time, port placement time, length of stay (LOS), ileus, anastomotic leakage, severe complications (Clavien-Dindo ≥ 3), reoperation, and 30-day mortality. An institutional learning curve for the surgical team was constructed and evaluated using the cumulative sum (CUSUM) test. A total of 121 procedures were analyzed (dV Si: n = 49; dV X/Xi: n = 72). Procedural profile shifted significantly (p = 0.002), with increased multiquadrant resections in the dV X/Xi group. Console time was longer in dV X/Xi group (p = 0.05), while total operative time and LOS were similar in the two groups. Postoperative outcomes were comparable. Parenteral nutrition was less frequently required in the dV X/Xi group (p = 0.02). CUSUM analysis showed a console learning plateau at 48 cases.We describe a real-world experience of robotic platform transition, demonstrating that it enabled an expanded range of procedures without compromising short-term outcomes.

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Chemiluminescence Immunoassay and Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry for Infliximab Monitoring: Method Validation and Clinical Comparability Study
papers.authors: Xia Y, Zhu M, Xiao M, Zhong C, Zhou Y, Xue Y
papers.abstract: Infliximab (IFX) is a cornerstone biologic for pediatric inflammatory bowel disease, where therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) is essential but complicated by inter-platform variability. Systematic comparison of automated immunoassays with reference methods is therefore warranted. This study aimed to validate an in-house chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) for IFX quantification and evaluate its agreement with liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). A CLIA kit was validated by assessing the limit of blank, specificity, linearity, accuracy, precision, matrix equivalence, and stability. IFX concentrations in 52 pediatric plasma samples were measured by CLIA and a reference LC-MS/MS method. Comparability was evaluated using linear regression, Passing-Bablok regression, and Bland-Altman analysis. CLIA showed excellent performance (lower limit of quantification: 0.640 µg/mL; specificity <10.0% interference; reportable range: 0.640-462 µg/mL). LC-MS/MS yielded higher concentrations than the CLIA (median: 6.25 vs. 2.87 µg/mL). Strong correlation was observed (r = 0.9101) with no significant deviation from linearity (Passing-Bablok, p > 0.05). However, Bland-Altman revealed substantial mean relative bias (67.9%) and poor categorical agreement (52% concordance) within the therapeutic range (3-7 µg/mL), indicating non-interchangeability. We validated a rapid, automated CLIA suitable for high-throughput TDM. Despite strong correlation, significant quantitative differences preclude direct result substitution, underscoring the need for method-specific therapeutic thresholds.

papers.abstract_zh: Infliximab (IFX) 是小兒發炎性腸道疾病的核心生物製劑，治療藥物監測（TDM）雖屬必要卻因平台間變異性而複雜化。因此有必要系統性比較自動化免疫分析法與參考方法。本研究目的為驗證院內化學發光免疫分析法（CLIA）用於IFX定量，並評估其與液相層析串聯質譜法（LC-MS/MS）的一致性。透過評估空白極限、特異性、線性、準確度、精密度、基質等效性及穩定性來驗證CLIA試劑套組。以CLIA與參考LC-MS/MS方法測量52份小兒血漿樣本中的IFX濃度。使用線性回歸、Passing-Bablok回歸及Bland-Altman分析評估可比較性。CLIA展現優異表現（定量下限：0.640 µg/mL；特異性干擾<10.0%；可報告範圍：0.640-462 µg/mL）。LC-MS/MS所測得濃度高於CLIA（中位數：6.25 對 2.87 µg/mL）。兩方法呈現強相關（r = 0.9101），Passing-Bablok分析未顯示顯著偏離線性（p > 0.05）。然而Bland-Altman分析顯示治療範圍內（3-7 µg/mL）存在顯著平均相對偏差（67.9%）且分類一致性不佳（52%一致性），顯示兩方法不可互換。我們驗證了一項快速、自動化且適合高通量TDM的CLIA方法。儘管相關性強，顯著的定量差異使結果無法直接替代使用，凸顯需訂定方法特異性的治療閾值。

papers.title: Exosome-delivered pepDCBLD2 promotes glucose metabolism to induce chemoresistance in colon cancer
papers.authors: Wang X, Yang J, Yang H, Xu Y, Wang H, Sun M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Oxaliplatin is a standard treatment for colon cancer, but chemoresistance is a considerable challenge. Dysregulation of circRNAs is involved in cancer and translatomics has found that some circRNAs encode polypeptides.
METHODS: Ribosome footprint profiling combined with circRNA sequencing was applied to screen circRNA with coding potential. Immunoprecipitation and mass spectrum were performed to explore the potential mechanism for regulating the downstream pathway. Ultracentrifugation and commercial kits were utilized to extract exosomes. Different kits were used to detect metabolic indexes. CCK-8, immunofluorescence and flow cytometry were conducted for the examination of oxaliplatin sensitivity. A xenograft model in NCG mice was established to demonstrate the pathway in vivo.
RESULTS: circDCBLD2 could encode pepDCBLD2 through rolling circle translation. pepDCBLD2, instead of the circRNA itself, participated in competitive binding to ubiquitin protein ligases, and upregulated the expression of the parent gene DCBLD2. Additionally, exosomes from drug resistant cells transferred pepDCBLD2 to sensitive cells, where it intercellularly regulated the DCBLD2/ERK/PKM2 pathway. This enhanced the glucose metabolism and reactive oxygen species scavenging capacity, ultimately promoting chemoresistance.
CONCLUSIONS: Exosome-delivered pepDCBLD2 encoded by circDCBLD2 promoted glucose metabolism to induce oxaliplatin resistance through the DCBLD2/ERK/PKM2 axis, which might be a potential therapeutic target for future treatment of chemoresistant colon cancer.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：奧沙利鉑（Oxaliplatin）是大腸癌的標準治療藥物，但化療抗藥性是一項重大挑戰。circRNA的失調與癌症相關，轉譯體學研究已發現部分circRNA可編碼多肽。方法：利用核醣體足跡定序（ribosome footprint profiling）結合circRNA定序，篩選具編碼潛力的circRNA。透過免疫沉澱與質譜分析探討調控下游路徑的潛在機制。以超高速離心及商業套組萃取外泌體，並用不同套組偵測代謝指標。以CCK-8、免疫螢光及流式細胞術檢測奧沙利鉑敏感性。建立NCG小鼠異種移植模型以驗證體內路徑。結果：circDCBLD2可透過滾環轉譯（rolling circle translation）編碼pepDCBLD2。pepDCBLD2（而非circRNA本身）參與競爭性結合泛素蛋白連接酶，並上調母基因DCBLD2的表現。此外，抗藥性細胞的外泌體可將pepDCBLD2轉移至敏感細胞，在細胞間調控DCBLD2/ERK/PKM2路徑，進而增強葡萄糖代謝與活性氧清除能力，最終促進化療抗藥性。結論：circDCBLD2編碼的外泌體遞送pepDCBLD2，透過DCBLD2/ERK/PKM2軸促進葡萄糖代謝，誘導奧沙利鉑抗藥性，可能是未來治療化療抗藥性大腸癌的潛在治療標的。

papers.title: Targeting the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway in gastrointestinal cancers: a comprehensive review of mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and clinical challenges
papers.authors: Kaikavoosnejad F, Haddad Kashani H, Dizaji Asl K, Mazloumi Z, Keyhani A, Ashraf Moosavi S
papers.abstract: Gastrointestinal (GI) cancers encompass malignant conditions of the GI tract and accessory digestive organs, including the esophagus, gastric cancer (GC), biliary system, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), pancreatic cancer (PC), and colorectal cancer (CRC). Globally, CRC ranks as the third most commonly diagnosed cancer, with gastric, hepatic, and esophageal cancers following in fifth, sixth, and seventh places, respectively. PC contributes notably to cancer mortality, ranking 12th in incidence and 7th in mortality. Despite major advances in diagnosis and treatment, GI cancers remain among the most aggressive malignancies and continue to drive substantial global morbidity and mortality. In 2020, GI cancers accounted for more than 4.8 million new cases and 3.4 million deaths. Although early-stage GI tumors can be surgically resected with curative intent, the overall 5-year relapse rate remains high. Neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy provide only modest long-term survival improvements when applicable. In recent decades, prognosis for advanced GI cancers has improved due to tailored therapies that combine cytotoxic and targeted agents and integrate systemic treatments with more effective surgical and locoregional approaches. Nevertheless, GI malignancies remain a leading cause of cancer death, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic options. A central molecular driver is the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling axis, which governs chemotherapy resistance, metastasis, survival, metabolism, and growth, and modulates the tumor microenvironment via angiogenesis and inflammatory infiltration. Dysregulation of this axis is common across GI cancers, guiding exploration of pathway-targeted therapies, alone or in combination. Although several agents show promise, toxicities such as neuropsychiatric effects, diarrhea, hepatotoxicity, and hyperglycemia limit clinical utility. Therefore, refined personalization and combination strategies targeting PI3K/AKT/mTOR are critical to improving efficacy and reducing resistance in GI malignancies.

papers.abstract_zh: 胃腸道（GI）癌症涵蓋消化道及附屬消化器官的惡性疾病，包括食道癌、胃癌（GC）、膽道系統癌、肝細胞癌（HCC）、胰臟癌（PC）與大腸直腸癌（CRC）。全球而言，CRC 為第三常見診斷癌症，胃癌、肝癌、食道癌則分別位居第五、六、七位。PC 對癌症死亡率貢獻顯著，發生率排名第12，死亡率排名第7。儘管診斷與治療已有重大進展，GI 癌症仍是最具侵襲性的惡性腫瘤之一，持續造成全球顯著的罹病率與死亡率。2020年，GI 癌症佔新增病例超過480萬例，死亡超過340萬例。雖然早期 GI 腫瘤可透過手術切除達到治癒目的，但整體五年復發率仍高。適用時，新輔助或輔助化療及放療僅能帶來有限的長期存活改善。近幾十年來，晚期 GI 癌症的預後已因結合細胞毒性與標靶藥物的個人化治療，以及將全身治療與更有效的手術及局部區域治療整合而有所改善。然而，GI 惡性腫瘤仍是癌症死亡的主要原因，凸顯出對新型治療選項的需求。PI3K/AKT/mTOR 訊號軸為核心分子驅動因子，主導化療抗藥性、轉移、存活、代謝與生長，並透過血管新生與炎症浸潤調節腫瘤微環境。此軸的失調在各種 GI 癌症中普遍存在，引導針對此路徑之標靶治療（單獨或合併使用）的探索。儘管多種藥物顯示出前景，但如神經精神症狀、腹瀉、肝毒性與高血糖等毒性限制了臨床應用。因此，針對 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 的精細化個人化與合併治療策略，對於提升療效並降低 GI 惡性腫瘤抗藥性至關重要。

papers.title: The evolution of hereditary cancer genetic counselling: mainstreaming, service redesign and patient experience in Lynch syndrome
papers.authors: Kohut K, Cable S, Ashokan A, Vicari S, Ditchfield H, Young J
papers.abstract: Genetic counselling for hereditary cancer predisposition has evolved substantially over more than three decades, driven by advances in genomic technologies and the growing use of tumour and germline testing. These developments have expanded access to hereditary cancer testing, treatment and prevention, while also introducing new clinical, psychosocial and system-level challenges. This review examines the transition from traditional specialist-led genetic counselling to mainstreamed testing pathways. Using Lynch syndrome as a paradigm, we explore how service redesign, personalised risk communication and patient experience intersect in contemporary hereditary cancer care. This invited review synthesises clinical, academic and patient perspectives on the evolution of hereditary cancer genetic counselling. Lived experiences of Lynch syndrome were incorporated through patient and public involvement contributors involved in manuscript development and interpretation. Mainstreamed testing has expanded access to genomic information and strengthened opportunities for cascade testing and prevention within families. However, it has also increased testing volumes, complexity of results interpretation and reliance on non-genetics clinicians. As a result, effective care requires close coordination between genetics and cancer services, alongside support for shared decision-making, family communication and psychosocial needs. This review uniquely integrates clinical evidence and lived experience to highlight how mainstreaming has transformed the delivery of hereditary cancer genetic counselling but not the need for specialist genetics expertise. Lynch syndrome illustrates how genomics can be integrated into routine cancer care while maintaining personalised counselling and family-centred follow-up. These principles are relevant across hereditary cancer predispositions and inform the future development of genetic counselling services.

papers.abstract_zh: 遺傳性癌症易感性的基因諮詢在過去三十多年間已有大幅演進，此演變由基因體技術的進步以及腫瘤與生殖細胞檢測日益普及所驅動。這些發展擴大了遺傳性癌症檢測、治療與預防的可及性，但同時也帶來新的臨床、心理社會與系統層面挑戰。本綜述檢視從傳統由專科醫師主導的基因諮詢，轉變為主流化檢測路徑的過程。以Lynch症候群作為典範，我們探討服務重新設計、個人化風險溝通與病人經驗如何在當代遺傳性癌症照護中交會。這篇受邀綜述整合了臨床、學術與病人觀點，論述遺傳性癌症基因諮詢的演變。Lynch症候群病人的親身經驗透過病人與公眾參與貢獻者納入手稿撰寫與詮釋過程。主流化檢測擴大了基因體資訊的可及性，並強化了家族內串聯檢測（cascade testing）與預防的機會。然而，這也增加了檢測量、結果詮釋的複雜度，以及對非基因專科臨床醫師的依賴。因此，有效的照護需要基因學與癌症服務之間的密切協調，並支持共享決策、家族溝通與心理社會需求。本綜述獨特地整合臨床證據與親身經驗，強調主流化雖已改變遺傳性癌症基因諮詢的提供方式，但並未消除對基因專科專業知識的需求。Lynch症候群說明了基因體學如何能整合進常規癌症照護中，同時維持個人化諮詢與以家庭為中心的追蹤。這些原則適用於各種遺傳性癌症易感性，並可為未來基因諮詢服務的發展提供參考。

papers.relevance_why: 討論的是基因諮詢服務組織與病人溝通模式（非外科介入或手術決策），且情境多為西方醫療體系的主流化政策，非台灣現行制度。
papers.one_liner: 以Lynch症候群為例，綜述基因諮詢從專科主導轉向主流化檢測模式，討論服務重組與病人經驗，無量化臨床結果數據。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此文屬服務模式討論非臨床證據，可留意台灣基因諮詢/遺傳門診轉介流程是否需優化，但無具體行動指引。
